assessment.classification: SHOWN static ambiguity; actual cause UNVERIFIED
assessment.subject: All-false is not five independent failures or proof of no timeout
assessment.detail: outcome complete means a correctly shaped returned dictionary, not successful semantic completion of each check. Pure evaluate catches BaseException and returns every key false. Remote wrapper initializes/returns all-false on multiple failures and its dedicated eight-second SIGALRM handler writes the same failure dictionary before hard exit. Therefore this valid returned result cannot distinguish failed predicate, import/config/archive/DB exception, teardown failure or inner deadline. It does not show each individual criterion was evaluated. No exact first predicate, error class, elapsed stage, raw response/types or DB rows is retained.
